plan.notes: Source: official LaGuardia Community College 'Computer Science, AS' degree map, https://www.laguardia.edu/majors/computer-science/ (transcribed 2026-09-30). Program (plan code CMPSC-AS, Dept. of Mathematics, Engineering and Computer Science) and per-course credit values verified against the official 2024-2025 Academic Catalog on laguardia.edu (newest full catalog published on the site; 713-page Coursedog PDF), cross-checked with the 2023-2024 catalog and the official Queens College Computer Science articulation agreement hosted on laguardia.edu — all credit values identical across sources. Prerequisite chain MAT 115/117 -> MAT 200 -> MAT 201 -> MAT 202 is printed on the degree map itself; no other prerequisites are stated on the map, so no others are recorded. Caveats: (1) The degree map's own courses sum to 62 credits (15+16+16+15) while the catalog states the AS degree minimum is 60 credits (program core 30 + required core 12 + flexible core 18); the map exceeds the minimum because MAT 200 and MAT 201 are 4-credit courses filling flexible-core slots — total_credits uses the sequence's own total of 62. (2) The four Flexible Core slots may be any course approved for a Flexible Core area (max two courses from any one discipline). (3) The map marks MAT 200 and MAC 125 as Session II (SII) courses. (4) All students must take one Urban Study course to graduate. (5) Students apply to graduate in their final semester.
